q: What emissions does a faecal sludge treatment plant produce?
title: Faecal sludge treatment emissions
short: Methane from sludge left without air is the main concern, with some nitrous oxide. Drying beds and well run aerobic stages emit less; anaerobic ponds emit more. Add electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25 and diesel for desludging trucks. Capturing biogas cuts methane.

ul: Methane from anaerobic tanks, ponds and stored sludge.

p: IPCC 2006 Volume 5 gives methods for wastewater and sludge. Methane is converted with the AR6 GWP for non-fossil methane, 27.0.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories
